This '''list of oldest companies in India''' includes brands and companies, excluding associations and [[List of oldest universities in continuous operation|educational]], governmental, or religious organisations. To be listed, a [[brand]] or [[company]] name must remain, either in whole or in part, since inception and should have been [[Partition of India|established before 1947]] and be currently operational. If the original name has since changed due to acquisitions or renaming, this must be verifiable.

The oldest company in India is the [[Wadia Group]], whose origins are traceable to 1736, with its subsidiary [[Bombay Burmah Trading Corporation|The Bombay Burmah Trading Corporation Limited]], established in 1863, being the oldest publicly traded company in India.<ref name="reward">{{Cite news |last=Mudgill |first=Amit |title=Old isn't gold always! These 19th century firms failed to reward investors in last 5 years |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/old-isnt-gold-always-these-19th-century-firms-failed-to-reward-investors-in-last-5-years/articleshow/57746374.cms |access-date=2022-09-19}}</ref>
